aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:77de89fb-.title: Software Engineer, Growth
aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:77de89fb-.company: Pre-Seed Series a Series b Series c Series D Series E IPO Gamma AI Build beautiful presentations with generative AI. Bay Area
aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:77de89fb-.description: ABOUT THE ROLE You'll build and optimize the experiences that turn visitors into users and users into paying customers. This means owning new user onboarding, activation funnels, viral loops, and monetization features including credit systems, paywalls, pricing experiments, and upgrade flows. You'll work across the full stack—from frontend UX to backend logic to analytics instrumentation—while running A/B tests and iterating rapidly based on data to move key metrics. As Software Engineer on the Growth team, you'll partner with PM, design, and data to drive measurable impact on our business. You'll balance scrappy experimentation with deliberate execution, moving fast when trying new ideas but slowing down when dealing with money. You'll be motivated by seeing growth and monetization metrics go up and to the right. Our team has a strong in-office culture and works in person 4–5 days per week in San Francisco. We love working together to stay creative and connected, with flexibility to work from home when focus matters most. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build and optimize onboarding flows, activation funnels, and viral loops that drive user growth - Implement monetization features including credit systems, paywalls, pricing experiments, and upgrade flows - Run A/B tests and iterate rapidly, building tooling to improve our experimentation framework - Own key growth metrics including sign-ups, activation rates, conversion, and retention - Work across the full stack from frontend to backend to analytics instrumentation - Partner with PM, design, and data to translate business goals into technical implementations WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 3+ years building production web applications with strong full-stack fundamentals - Proficiency in TypeScript, React, and Node.js (or strong fundamentals in similar technologies) - Strong product and business sense with motivation to move growth and monetization metrics - Data-driven mindset with comfort using A/B testing, analytics, and interpreting metrics - Ability to move fast when experimenting but also slow and deliberately when dealing with credits and payments - Scrappy approach with comfort in ambiguity and iterative shipping - Experience with growth/monetization systems like onboarding, paywalls, referrals, or payment flows (Nice to have) COMPENSATION RANGE: The base salary for this full-time position, which spans multiple internal levels depending on qualifications, ranges between $180K - $310K plus benefits & equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to experience and expertise in the requirements listed above. If you're interested in this role but you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway! We're always excited about meeting great people.

agentiscapitaladvisors-agentis-capital-a.title: Director, Investment Banking - Renewables
agentiscapitaladvisors-agentis-capital-a.description: Our Firm Agentis Capital Advisors is a leading global financial advisor with a reputation for delivering unparalleled value and advice to its clients. The firm has been the recipient of numerous industry rewards in recent years, including 2024 P3 Awards Financial Advisor of the Year, multiple 2023 industry deal awards, Proximo Infra's 2022 North American Financial Advisor of the Year, and IJGlobal's 2022 Judge's Choice Award. Our guiding principles and ability to generate value for clients sets us apart. Agentis acts as a sell-side and buy-side advisor on a wide variety of global transactions including renewable power, energy, digital, transportation, and public-private partnerships. Our clients include leading infrastructure funds, pension funds, contractors, and governments. The Opportunity As Director, you will play a pivotal leadership role in leading our North American financial advisory practice. You will be expected to pitch financial advisory mandates, manage complex transactions concurrently, build and train a growing team of practitioners, and consistently provide high-quality, bespoke services to our clients. This role requires a strategic mindset, strong leadership skills, a deep understanding of the infrastructure finance landscape, and expertise in deal management and technical delivery. Key Responsibilities - Drive technical delivery excellence by overseeing financial modeling, due diligence, and transaction execution; - Lead transaction teams to successfully execute financial advisory mandates; - Mentor, develop, and manage junior team members; - Develop and maintain relationships with clients and key stakeholders within the infrastructure sector; - Identify, develop, and pitch financial advisory opportunities; and - Position Agentis as the pre-eminent independent financial advisor in the North American infrastructure space. Our Differentiators - Exceptional level of responsibility on complex transactions across verticals and financial products; - Opportunities to work on global transactions; - Continuous internal training and leadership development programs; - Competitive compensation, employee ownership, and comprehensive benefits package; - Paid sabbatical every two years of employment; - Entrepreneurial culture with a clear path to partnership; and - Access to principal investment opportunities alongside Partners. Your Skills and Experience - Minimum eight years of relevant experience in infrastructure finance as a sponsor or as a financial advisor; - Strong deal management and technical delivery capabilities; - Demonstrated ability to structure and execute infrastructure mandates; - Successfully closed challenging infrastructure transactions; - Strong business development and client relationship skills; - Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills; - Ability to work with geographically dispersed teams; - Ability to work under pressure and consistently deliver high-quality work with strict deadlines to meet team and client objectives; and - Willingness and ability to travel. Position Type - Permanent Full-Time - Location: Remote - Desired start date: Immediately

jobgether-jobgether:lever:71133448-6905-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. UI/UX Designer based in Netherlands. This is a senior design role focused on creating intuitive, polished, and engaging digital experiences across web and mobile products. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. This is a fully remote position requiring strong communication, autonomy, attention to detail, and availability during AEST working hours. Design intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products, balancing usability, aesthetics, and technical feasibility. Translate briefs, business objectives, and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and polished digital experiences. Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience. Establish and maintain strong visual design systems, applying disciplined grids, spacing, typography, hierarchy, and responsive layouts. Use AI-powered design and creative tools to accelerate ideation, exploration, and rapid prototyping while maintaining a high standard of design quality. Collaborate closely with developers and technical teams throughout the design process to ensure accurate and practical implementation. Present design concepts and decisions clearly to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders, incorporating feedback while confidently explaining design rationale. Take ownership of projects from initial concept through final delivery, identifying problems and developing thoughtful, creative solutions. Help structure and organise design work, documentation, and workflows so projects progress efficiently across distributed teams. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Digital Design, or a comparable senior design position. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Excellent written and verbal English, with confidence presenting designs and articulating the reasoning behind design decisions.
